name: Mizuno Ryouko
source:
Ryouko is [url=https://vndb.org/c38472]Yousuke[/url]'s step-sister and [url=https://vndb.org/c23252]Shizuka[/url]'s only child and daughter. Contrary to her mother, she's very quiet and terse, preferring to observe others rather than absorb attention herself. Despite her laconic nature, she's admired in school. She does her best to keep track of Yousuke and make sure he's doing alright on his own.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/565978-tsuki-possession/faqs/28692]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url] and Erogereview]
